title: All-In Alpha
author: DriftingCheese
selftext: I do some stock trading and besties talk a lot about trade ideas/companies, make predictions etc. So I wanted to track their ideas, see how they pan out and keep a score. Built the site mainly for me, but maybe you can find it useful as well. Not planning to make any money with it, just a fun side project with AI. [allinalpha.io](https://allinalpha.io)
